baseline.response:
Trace both import paths through the shared destination-path helper to the filesystem write. Compare their root arguments, normalization, containment checks, and handling of absolute paths, traversal, and symlinks. Determine whether the failing caller bypasses a correct helper or exposes a shared defect.

Repair the narrowest owner of the violated invariant. If the helper guarantees root-contained destinations, fix that helper and add regression coverage through both callers. If the helper is sound but one caller supplies the wrong root or bypasses it, repair that caller. A caller-only guard is justified only after establishing that it does not leave the same defect reachable elsewhere.
